plan: Drive: from Village of Burns Lake, about 74 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate). Via Tibbets Creek Rd, Hwy 16, Hwy 35, Brown Rd.
Park: 53.77275, -126.00673, pull off on an unnamed gravel road. Map links below.
Walk: 5.9 km S, cross country, no trail mapped. Climb about 31 m, about 121 min at 3 km/h.
Camp: flat ground 80 m NE of the spot at 881 m (53.72079, -126.01595). Water: unnamed wetland 80 m SW (estimate).
Hunt: moose, Sept, Oct, Nov (season rows). Glass the wetland and cutblock edges at dawn and dusk. Move slowly, stop often (Tip).
Use: .308 Winchester, 165 to 180 grain premium bullet, shots inside about 200 m (219 yd) (Tip).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 6-2, Region 6. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2026-10-02, closures 2026-10-16.
R6F-moose-backcountry-0005.popWhy: Less popular (quieter): MU 6-2: about 860 hunter days a year for moose (2020 to 2024 mean), 0.18 days per square km, middle third of BC MUs; access: more than 5 km from a drivable road. Estimate, about 50% sure (my pick).
